description: Fork of exp475 (LION, 1.4962). SINGLE change: replace all 4 TinyMultiHeadLut with TinyOrderedMultiHeadLut(CONNECTED_TRIPLETS). NAP=6 -> 2 triplets/table, max_orders=36 (vs 64).
